text:
alex: Heads-up: customer Acme reported increased failure rate in streaming path after launch. Need to decide bug vs enhancement.
maya: Seen it. Logs show NPE in prefix cache on 2048 tokens for some requests. Ticket: https://tracker/RED-1243
jonah: If it's an NPE causing ~5% errors, mark as P0 bug for launch SLA. What's repro rate and rollback risk?
alex: Repro ~0.3% of total prod requests but concentrated on enterprise tenants. Impact: failed calls + retries — visible to customers. SLA hit risk for Dedicated customers.
sophie: Recommend hotfix canary for 48h, then full roll in next deploy window. Owners: eng-runtime + eng-sre. Does that block planned follow-ons?
maya: It does. If we hotfix now, we push prompt-slice caching improvements (planned for next sprint).
jonah: Tradeoff table suggestion: Bug (hotfix) — timeline 3d, immediate customer relief; Enhancement — 2w sprint, reduces long-run cost but leaves errors.
alex: Proposed launch criteria: 'no >1% error rate over 24h on enterprise tenants' and 'high-impact regressions triaged within 4h'. Agree?
sophie: :thumbsup: Agree. Add canary thresholds and rollback plan.
maya: I'll label the ticket: prod-bug, hotfix, canary, customer-impact and assign to @jonah.
jonah: Assigned. I'll kick off canary today. devex-bot: start canary job
devex-bot: deploy-bot: canary job started for RED-1243 on cluster prod-canary-3. Alerts to #eng-oncall.
alex: If canary passes, aim patch release Thu deploy window. If fails, escalate to emergency patch window.
sophie: Also propose deprioritizing prompt-slice improvements by one sprint and run a 1-week profiling spike to cut tail latency — less risky.
maya: I'll draft customer-facing comms and DM Acme contacts with ETA + canary updates.
alex: Post-launch milestone cadence proposal: 'stabilize' (0–2w), 'patches' (2–6w), 'follow-on enhancements' (6–12w). Thoughts?
jonah: Works for me. I'll create a product doc page with owners and acceptance criteria per milestone.
alex: Action items: jonah: run canary & update RED-1243; maya: customer comms; sophie: adjust sprint; alex: update roadmap + announce in all-hands. OK?
maya: on it
jonah: on it
sophie: on it
alex: Thanks — will sync up after canary completes.
